about: Modwerk source-only sample-rate package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/sample-rate.

mods.title: Improved SMPL
mods.summary: The SAMPLE page, improved: TUN in cents, FIN's knob as RATE (to a stop and into reverse), LOP PIPO for ping-pong loops, FUNC + STA or END to zero crossings, and SMPL always shows the waveform under one row of values.
mods.description: The SAMPLE page, improved: TUN in cents, FIN's knob as RATE (to a stop and into reverse), LOP PIPO for ping-pong loops, FUNC + STA or END to zero crossings, and SMPL always shows the waveform under one row of values.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: This package's source links to the same image as 0.6.0, which ran alone on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 from RAM in a test image with the author's private development base (MSU1); the author's rig and the author's own playing found it working, as the author reports.
